title: Tribes of Behavior
page_title: Tribes of Behavior — Iberia, 1100 BCE to now
tagline: Not the map of who governed, but of what people did — the tongues, creeds and work that spread across the Iberian peninsula like molds on a peach, and how their networks stopped needing to touch once signals outran bodies.
card_question: What did 'Spain' do — and who, underneath, was doing it?
source: hand-authored, schematic · from general histories of Iberia · a sketch of the mechanism, not a measurement
discussion_prompt: Pick a point and watch its fiber change. What stayed the same there the longest?
